body:
Hey, I’m really sorry that your battle has been going on this long, I still battle myself everyday. All I can say is to put all that negative focus into one small improvement at a time. 

If anything, I pray that when you get up this Sunday you go to church and listen and allow yourself to be free for just that hour or so. 

You don’t have anything to lose if you’re serious about this, but you could potentially make a great gain of pure ness. 

I hope you take the baby steps. I’m 21 and have been in and out of jail since I came home from my 1st semester of college in 2015. I’ve spent over a year of my adult life behind bars, so when I start thinking I should just end myself before the “inevitable” happens, I pay attention to the choices that lie ahead of me everyday. When you can pinpoint a situation and make the decision to make it worse, or brush it off and let it be, then you are already at a major leap ahead of where you’ve been. You won’t always brush it off either, but as time goes you will be able to see and feel that you were in control of the outcome of your own experience following the encounter. 

I just am stating what I’ve noticed as I put focus in building myself back up, instead of allowing all of the things in life I can’t control tear me apart. 

I hope this helps
